title: Pilot jurisdiction budget source vetting (license verified) + snapshot + provenance
context: Before any pilot-jurisdiction budget explainer can be generated, the budget sources for that jurisdiction must be identified, license-verified, snapshotted, and their provenance recorded. This is a data task that gates all M2 content work. It depends on the pilot jurisdiction selection (task 000, which is TO BE SECURED until the jurisdiction is decided by 2026-08-31), the license/provenance gate (task 004), and the ingest pipeline (task 006). No budget explainer can be generated from an unverified source. Expert sign-off must be recorded before sources are enabled.
objective: Identify, vet, snapshot, and record full provenance for the pilot jurisdiction's open budget data sources — verifying that each source carries an open/PD/CC/open-gov reuse-and-derivatives license, pinning a sha256-checksummed snapshot, and recording full provenance — so that budget explainer generation (task 011) has a license-clean, reproducible input.
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse terms verified and recorded per source: only open/PD/CC/open-gov licensed sources that permit derivatives are enabled; no proprietary or paywalled data included
Snapshot pinned (sha256) and full provenance recorded for each source: publisher, citation, URL, retrieval date, license, legal-status note, and permits-derivatives flag
Sources passed through the license/provenance gate (task 004) and provenance manifest emitted
Public-finance expert sign-off recorded before sources are enabled, scoped to the dataset snapshot and checksum
Dataset output is a provenance manifest listing all enabled sources with their provenance records
output: A provenance manifest (dataset) listing all enabled pilot-jurisdiction budget sources with verified licenses, sha256-checksummed snapshots, full provenance records, and recorded public-finance expert sign-off — the license-clean, reproducible input for budget explainer generation.
